_comment: Public distribution snapshot with no scheduled tasks. A job entry declares id, title, schedule, timezone, target, kind (shell with command, or agent), cwd, timeoutSeconds, maxRunsPerDay, failureLimit, optional noOpMarker, and prompt; t3/scheduled/guard.mjs enforces the limits because a T3 scheduled task has none. Creating, enabling, or changing a T3 task is an owner decision outside installation.
